title: neurogenomics/Empirical_Power_Analysis pipeline parameters
description: Empirical power analysis for single-cell RNA-seq differential expression

input_output_options.title: Input / output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

raw_data.description: Path to directory containing raw single-cell input files (h5ad, qs, h5Seurat).
raw_data.help_text: Place (or symlink) all raw cohort files here before running. See REPRODUCE.md §1 for the expected filenames per dataset.

shards_dir.description: Path where donor-level shard files (SingleCellExperiment .qs) will be written by the sharding step.

tracedir.description: Directory for Nextflow execution reports (timeline, trace, dag).

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Parameters controlling the Cartesian downsampling grid and model fitting.

downsample_mode.description: Cartesian grid axis: downsample by number of cells ('cells') or sequencing reads ('reads').

n_robustness.description: Number of independent ground-truth / validation splits (robustness runs). Increasing this number improves estimate stability but multiplies compute cost.

n_subsamples.description: Number of subsamples drawn at each Cartesian grid point per robustness run.

render_paper.description: Whether to render the manuscript Rmd (requires the figure-data step to have completed).

compute_options.title: Compute options
compute_options.description: Default core counts passed to R pipelines for within-pipeline parallelism.

cores_default.description: Default number of cores passed to run_pipeline.R scripts for future.apply parallelism.

cores_heavy.description: Core count for the Cartesian downsampling step (120k DESeq2 runs).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised nf-core config profiles.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.
